title: Moreish Puff Sherbet Strawberry Laces Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: A two-for-one confectionary treat, this delicious e-liquid from Moreish Puff blends sweet, smooth Strawberry candy laces with the refreshing tickle of fizzy sherbet on the exhale. Moreish Puff’s Nic Salt e-liquid’s nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief and smooth throat hit provided by nic salts.
